dboxTimeline.speaker: Shinra
dboxTimeline.text: Readings under the temple. The fayth are gone.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Brother
dboxTimeline.text: Nooj! Gippal! They went down there!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Buddy
dboxTimeline.text: Hole's under the statue. Straight down.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Then that's our way in. Let's go.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: A road made of floating rocks. Cozy.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: It's the road to the Farplane.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: She used to come when I called.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: All three of you? Even you...

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: One down. They can't combine now.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: We're three sisters too, sort of.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Paine
dboxTimeline.text: Back to the ship. Then down.
